items.quote: Outside the Al-rich corner, the three samples with the compositions Al35Ce20Si45, Al40Ce20Si40, and Al45Ce25Si30 (at. pct) were studied by DTA performed in a Netzsch DTA 404S (Netzsch-Gerätebau GmBH, Selb, Germany) apparatus.
The microstructures of the samples after arc melting (ascast), after heat treatment and after slow cooling in DSC/DTA experiments, were examined by scanning electron microscopy.

items.instrument: Siemens D5000 (Bruker AXS, Karlsruhe, Germany) diffractometer
items.quote: The measurements were performed using a Siemens D5000 (Bruker AXS, Karlsruhe, Germany) diffractometer with a step 0.02 deg of 2 and 3 seconds exposition time in the point.
Both the reaction temperatures and the solidification enthalpy were measured by DSC in a heat-flux twin cylindrical Calvet-type calorimetric system, Setaram MHTC 96 (Setaram, Caluire, France).
